AnswerCallV3.description:
The public Answer call (CONTRACT "Public Answer call", user decision of
25 November 2026): `task` alone, or the existing full request with
`schema`, `question` and `budget`. Every reader converts it with
[`AnswerCallV3::into_request`], so both forms give one canonical request.
The field comments are the advertised argument descriptions.

anchors.description:
Up to 16 exact strings from the task (identifiers, routes, quoted
text, numbers with units), at most 200 bytes each.

budget.description:
Optional with task: omitted uses the service default, a valid budget
is used as sent. Required with question.

continuation.description: A ticket or continuation id, to attach to an existing job.

deliverable.description:
What you will produce. It selects standing needs the reply also
covers: project rules, how tests run, the build file.

known.description:
Up to 32 path ranges you already read. Checked; does not change
gathering yet.

needs.description:
Up to 8 statements of what you must learn, one each, at most 400
bytes. Stating needs improves the result.

question.description: Existing full request only, with schema and budget; never with task.

schema.description: Existing full request only; supplied by the service for task.

task.description: The whole task in your words; it becomes the question.

AnswerDeliveryRecord.description:
What one delivery of a service-owned Answer job was: beside the reply,
never inside it.

job.description: The job's handle; it grants nothing.

reused.description: This call did not make the work it received.

run_ms.description: Dispatch to finish, or to now while the job runs.

wait_ms.description: This call's own wait; equal to the reply's `elapsed_ms`.

AnswerJobOptions.description:
Job options beside an Answer /3 request, never inside it, so the request
digest is unchanged (CONTRACT "Answer job options and delivery record").

fresh.description: Start an independent run; never reuse a job by digest.

interactive.description:
The job may run to completion with no caller waiting. It never ranks
a job ahead of an attended one.

invocation_key.description: Exact retry recovery within the caller's own scope.

wait_ms.description: How long this call waits; never shortens the job.

deadline_share_ms.description: This part's share of the deadline, after any early finisher's return.

gaps.description: The /2 gap kinds that remain for this part, beside the sub-need kinds.

shortened.description: The part was shortened to fit the shared reply frame.

AnswerTicket.description: Times are milliseconds from the reply.

BasisSummary.description:
The source units the decision that stands rests on; the full EvidenceRef
list is in the log. When a model's choice stands, `presented` counts the
byte ranges the model was shown and `omitted` the ranges of the same
spans it was not shown. When the deterministic order decided (no model,
a call not dispatched, refused or lost, or an abstention), `presented`
counts the whole spans that order read and `omitted` is 0.

calls.description: Canonical reads over the whole Answer.

candidates.description: Candidate records over the whole Answer, before dedup.

fanout.description: Peak concurrent reads in one round of one part.

input_tokens.description: Model input token pool of the whole attempt.

max_bytes.description:
Bytes retained while gathering; the reply takes at most the smaller
of this and 131,072 bytes.

round_input_tokens.description: Model input tokens of one round of one part.

CardAdvice.description: Same immutable native bindings as advice /2, for one batched card call.

card_slot.description: The card call's slot, shared by all of its segments.

CardClass.description: What a card proposes. Each class belongs to exactly one stage.

oneOf.description: A whole partition of the request into two to four ordered ranges.
The partition of the request into one range.
Include a proposed sub-need.

CardRecord.description:
A presented card: decision symbol, class, text digest and, for Split
cards, the ordered partition of the question it proposes.

oneOf.description: Parts found different definitions for one name: two or more records.
Parts judged the same evidence differently: one record or more.

ContextActionAdvice.description: Same immutable native bindings as Advice, with a distinct joint-task schema.

ContextActionRoster.description: Frozen native alternatives, not an arbitrary model-supplied operation list.

anchors.description:
Exact strings from the caller's task. Each gets an exact lookup in
round one. An anchor is data, never a pattern.

continuation.description: A ticket or continuation id, to attach to an existing job.

known.description:
Source the caller already holds. Evidence wholly inside a known range
is withheld and counted.

needs.description:
What the caller must find out, one fact each. When present these are
the request's sub-needs, in this order, and the kernel derives none.

decisions.description: Compact card decisions, oldest deterministic ones omitted first.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from admission to the reply, set by the kernel.

gathering.description:
Per-stage counts and timings of the kernel's gathering. Absent on a
ticket reply.

omitted_evidence.description: Ids of cited records the reply frame omitted.

read_status.description:
The per-read status (freshness and readiness observations) of the
mandatory first search, carried once for the reply. Records never
repeat it and no record id or digest binds it (change-log entry 54).
Absent when the read carried none, or when the transport renders the
reply without status (terse, `include_status` false).

scope.description: The one index partition this Answer ran on.

oneOf.description: One chosen Answer loop card, by text digest.
Several chosen Answer loop cards (Plan), in roster order.

basis.description:
What the decision that stands rests on. When a model's choice
stands: the byte ranges of the spans it was shown, then, as omitted,
the ranges of those spans it was not shown (the text before and after
an excerpt, and whole spans not shown). When the deterministic order
decided: the whole spans it read, and nothing omitted.

scores.description: Raw scores in card order; empty when no model scored.

DecisionLogSummary.description: What the reply says about the whole decision log.

attribution.description: Model tokens charged per part and round by every card and Focus receipt.

counts.description: Decisions per stage and source, over the whole log.

digest.description: Digest of the complete custody log.

timings.description: Measured model timings summed over every receipt.

work_unknown.description: Decisions and Focus calls whose work is unknown.

DecisionRecord.description: The compact reply form of one card decision.

batched_with.description: Ordinals of the other decisions scored in the same card call.

card_slot.description: The card call this decision was scored in; batched segments share it.

ordinal.description: Position in the whole decision log, from 1.

receipt.description: The card advice receipt's input digest, held in the decision log.

roster_digest.description: Digest of the presented roster (stage and every card record).

top.description: Top and runner-up raw scores and their margin, in native units.

work_unknown.description: A submitted call whose reply was lost: its work stays charged, unknown.

oneOf.description:
A Context model was present, but no card call was dispatched for this
roster: the call had no slot, token share, excerpt room or time left,
or the model was not usable. The deterministic order decided. The
reason is `token_budget`, `deadline` or `unavailable`.

No Context model takes part, or the roster holds one card; the
deterministic order decided.

Degradation.description: What was reduced or left out, and why.

oneOf.description:
No Context model decided: no card call was dispatched, and every card
decision took the deterministic order.
Context decisions that abstained and fell back.
No Focus model ran: candidates kept their canonical order.
A part received less than its share of a model stage.
A submitted model call's outcome is unknown; its slot stays charged.
The configuration changed during the Answer; later decisions are historical.
A batched model call was split to fit.
Focus over the search results was deferred.
Admission planned fewer parts (section 12.4.1).

A stage's model did not run: `applied` is absent, the no-model loop.
(A step down to a smaller model left with the Large model; the field
stays so the wire shape is unchanged.)
Down the device ladder, from a GPU to the CPU.

Deliverable.description: What the caller will produce from the gathered context.

oneOf.description: Split only on explicit enumerations and separate questions.

context_retired.description:
The Context selection a migration retired (a Large selection of
configuration/4 or /3). The Context stage is then disabled with no
model; the next Context configuration clears it.

DeviceExecution.description:
GPU-only additive Profile field. None preserves every legacy CPU serialization.
Hashes name compiled, authenticated native policies, not ambient strings or capabilities.

original_order.description: Complete canonical returned candidate order, including the unscored tail.

presentations.description: Exact source windows prepared for scoring, not proof of successful FFI.

scores.description: Scored candidates MUST be the exact original prefix, in original order.

order_digest.description: Digest of the complete canonical candidate order, tail included.

questions_digest.description: Digest of the ordered distinct questions.

ranked.description: The ranked permutation of candidate indexes.

scope_digest.description: Framed digest of the exact ScopeBinding; the record carries the scope.

FocusObservation.description:
Only the canonical Search field carries this observation. A compact notice
is known pre-dispatch absence, never a substitute for unknown native work.

FocusPairScore.description: One scored (candidate, question) pair, by index into the call's request.

FocusProfileLimits.description: Facts from an actual authenticated qualified profile, never caller authority.

relevance.description: Publisher two-logit normalization; not calibrated sufficiency/confidence.

target.description: Query wording, identifier, path or name, from what was read.

GatheringReads.description: Reads of one operation dispatched in a stage.

GatheringReport.description:
Per-stage counts and timings of one Answer's gathering. Disclosure only:
no record id, digest or decision binds it.

rules.description: The gathering rules that were on for this request.

GatheringRule.description:
A gathering rule of the kernel's Answer loop (kernel CONTRACT "Gathering
rules"), named in a reply's `gathering` when it was on for the request.

GatheringSkip.description:
Why a gathering stage admitted no read (kernel CONTRACT "Gathering
rules", rule 7).

oneOf.description: The stage's rule is off for this request; it made no lookup.

The Answer stopped (budget, deadline or a stale publication) before
the stage began; it made no lookup.
No calls or candidates were left within the stage's room.
No retention bytes were left within the stage's allowance.
There was no located passage to plan from.
Its lookups found nothing new to read.

GatheringStage.description: What one gathering stage did and how long it took.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock time spent in this stage.

lookups.description:
Private index lookups charged as calls (code facts, listings,
references); they choose reads and are never evidence themselves.

model_judgments.description: Focus pairs and card decisions taken in this stage.

passages_delivered.description: Passages from this stage's records the reply delivers to a sub-need.

passages_fetched.description: Hits of the records this stage retained.

passages_offered.description: (sub-need, passage) pairs this stage put before a sub-need's ranking.

reads.description: Evidence reads admitted in this stage, by operation.

skipped.description:
Why the stage admitted no read, when it admitted none. Omitted when
the stage read something, or for a stage that gives no reason.

GatheringStageKind.description: A stage of the kernel's gathering, as `gathering` reports it.

oneOf.description: Round one's searches and their recipe reads.
Project guidance files: folder listings and reads.
Files the evidence names by path.
Enclosing definitions, callees, call sites and users of inherited types.
Round barriers: Focus, coverage and follow-up choices.
The reads of rounds two and later.
Choosing each sub-need's passages, Compose and Union.

GpuProbeReservation.description:
Unqualified probe request bounds only, never measured fit, residency or
release authority. Actual native owner must independently admit these limits.

effective_independent_cases.description:
Must be justified by the separately approved exact cluster analysis.
It is not inferred from the number of task rows or repositories.

class_support.description: Absent on historical /1; /2 explicitly accounts for all four classes.

KnownRange.description: A repository-relative path, whole or with inclusive one-based lines.

task.description: The card task this policy admits decisions for.

LoopCalibrationSet.description:
One document per Context profile, holding a LoopCalibration per admitted
card task. The profile keeps its single Calibration asset: that asset's
bytes are this document and its SHA-256 is the profile's `calibration`.

entries.description: In card-task order: Split, Plan, Coverage, FollowUp, each at most once.

LoopEvidence.description:
One deduplicated canonical read, merged by location and content digest.
Its scope is the reply's `scope`; a v3 record never repeats it. A loop
search defers in-search Focus, so it carries no Focus receipt.

focus_profile.description:
The Focus profile every identified batched Focus receipt ran on, so a
delivery owner can bind the Focus stage from the reply alone (the
receipts stay in custody). Null when no Focus receipt is identified.

LoopRead.description: Canonical reads the loop may dispatch or propose.

minimum_raw_margin.description: Raw top-runner margin the unique global top card must reach.

LoopStage.description: The loop's stages, step 0 to step 6, with admission before them.

oneOf.description: An accepted calibration rule admitted the top card.
The top score, with no calibration rule in force.
Every sub-need is covered.
The question needs clarification (the /2 clarification terminal).
No proposed read is justified (the /2 no-read terminal).
A round added nothing new.
The round limit was reached.

continuation.description: The still-running job to attach to.

RecordUse.description: One finding of a retained record: provenance naming every part and sub-need.

need.description: Absent for a part's own search.

RetiredModel.description:
A selection the service retired and cleared on migration. Status reports it
until the stage is configured again; it is never a selection.

oneOf.description: The Large Context model (`context_large` in configuration/4).

follow_ups_run.description: Follow-ups chosen at the end of the previous round and run in this one.

input_tokens.description: Observed model input tokens charged to this part in this round.

new_evidence.description: Candidate records first found by this part in this round, retained or not.

round.description: Numbered from 1, consecutive within its part.

sub_needs_covered.description: Sub-needs judged covered at the end of this round.

ordinal.description: The decision ordinal this roster segment answers.

raw_scores.description: Raw scores in card order and native units.

oneOf.description: The Focus reranker (Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B), the one model of the Focus stage.

The Arbiter (Qwen3-1.7B, `ModelChoice::ContextQwenCompact`), the one
model of the Context stage. Wire value `arbiter`.

model.description: The scoring model; absent for deterministic decisions.

initialization.description: Presence marks configuration as a non-writable disabled placeholder.

evidence.description: Record ids this sub-need cites, retained or omitted by the frame.

evidence_omitted.description: How many cited records the frame omitted.

origin.description: Who stated this sub-need. Absent means the kernel derived it.

unrun_reads.description: Reads chosen or proposed but not run, for the agent to run itself.

oneOf.description: The kernel derived it from the question.
The caller stated it in the request's `needs`.

The kernel added it by the request's `deliverable`: a need every piece
of work of that kind has and callers seldom state.
Answer loop card tasks (final plan section 12), each with its own policy.

axes.description: Profile-pinned symbolic axes; batch is always one.

human_review_reference.description: Descriptive attribution only; exact original file needs separate approval.

freeze.description: Exact preregistered criteria source; independently approved at promotion.

scores.description: None retains an unscored refusal/failure in the complete population denominator.

native_execution_receipt.description: Actual native custody/source receipt, independently reviewed with capture.

TokenAttribution.description:
Model tokens charged to one part and round. Part 0 is the whole question
(Split); round 0 is before the rounds (Split and Plan).

dedup_count.description: Findings merged into a record another part also found.

overlaps_trimmed.description:
Spans trimmed of text that another span of the same file carries
(`overlaps`). Absent when there is none.

repeats_merged.description:
Spans of the retained records whose text the reply carries once, in
another span: exact repeats, and spans that lie within a longer span
of the same file. Each such span names the one that carries its text
(`same_as`). Absent when there is none.

oneOf.description: The part's own search, in round one.
A sub-need's search, in round one.
A structural read of round one.
A follow-up read of a later round.
Served from the shared read cache.

VariantReference.description:
Exactly two logical model slots; variants do not add selected models.
Each reference resolves only through the authenticated native catalog owner.
